title: Lorie Barnes visited by blue dwarfs while pregnant

tellings.quote: We're interested in the girl child you're carrying.

plain: In 1954, a woman named Lorie Barnes was visited by small blue beings while she was pregnant, and they told her: "We're interested in the girl child you're carrying." The writer Whitley Strieber, known for his accounts of his own encounters with such beings, passes on the story as she told it to him. He tells it as an example of visitors taking an interest in particular families across generations.
